web_context.competitor_activity: Seagate (STX) reported Q3 FY26 revenue of $3.1B (+44% YoY) with non-GAAP gross margin of 47% (all-time high) — strong but WDC outpaces on revenue and margin (50%+). HDD market is an effective duopoly (WDC ~45% share, Seagate ~40%+) with 2026 capacities fully committed; competition has shifted to who scales 40TB+ drives fastest. WDC divested SanDisk in February 2026 for $3.1B, becoming a pure-play HDD company. Micron's strong NAND earnings validated the broader storage supercycle, benefiting the sector. Key long-term risk: a breakthrough in 3D-NAND layering that dramatically lowers SSD costs could threaten HDD demand for warm storage.
